roms.cl:
(System)
Fixed the issue of tablets failing to share mobile network in some scenarios.
Fixed an issue where game sound effects would occasionally turn off abnormally in the Game Toolbox.
Fixed the issue of volume adjustment stuttering in some third-party applications in accessibility mode.
Fixed an issue where the "Return to Desktop" button occasionally failed to work in Accessibility Mode.
(Free window)
Fixed an issue where the free-form window would display abnormally when switching to full screen in certain scenarios.
(Desktop)
Fixed an issue where the swipe-up return-to-home function was malfunctioning in some scenarios.
(Notes)
Fixed an occasional issue with abnormal categorization display in notes.
Fixed an issue where the titles of notes were occasionally not displayed completely in the note list.
(Camera)
The new feature supports single-camera location recommendations, automatically identifies nearby camera locations, and provides one-click navigation to the shooting location.
Fixed an issue where icons occasionally displayed incorrectly in the camera preview interface.
(Weather)
Fixed occasional weather display issues
(Recorder)
Fixed the issue of recorder transcription failure in some scenarios.

[Basic experience]
Reduced system load and memory use for lasting smooth performance
New: Precision workload scheduling helps optimize system-wide performance
Optimization: System workload scheduling handles tasks more efficiently, while redundant instructions have been removed to improve performance and reduce power consumption
Optimization: CPU processing and GPU rendering workloads consume less power
Optimization: Graphics rendering reduces UI power consumption and stuttering
Optimization: Game frequency scaling delivers more stable frame rates in demanding scenarios such as team battles
  
New: Memory preloading helps apps respond faster
Optimization: Memory reservation and allocation reduce resource use and memory usage after startup
Optimization: Background resource scheduling loads resources only when needed and staggers background tasks to reduce memory use and improve performance
Optimization: Memory preloading and storage prefetching reduce occasional stuttering and frame drops, speed up cold starts, and improve app responsiveness
   
New: Xiaomi HyperOS app runtime environment helps system apps run more smoothly and use resources more efficiently
Optimization: Home screen and Gallery interactions provide smoother visuals and more responsive controls
Optimization: Gallery and Weather use fewer CPU and memory resources in the background
[Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi]
Upgraded Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi now understands you better and makes everyday tasks easier
New interactions:
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi supports Xiaomi HyperIsland, letting you follow the progress of long-running AI tasks in real time. Notifications automatically expand when tasks are complete.
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi action bubble. Swipe in from the side and pause to bring it up, then point to on-screen content to ask questions or take action. Drag it to a location to start navigation, or to an event to add it to your calendar.
Optimization: The default Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi voice sounds more natural
Optimization: The Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi start page makes it easier to view previous tasks, open your profile, or start a new conversation using the tabs at the bottom
Pro mode:
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi offers Pro mode for complex and scheduled tasks across apps and devices, with cloud-based tools for document processing and webpage creation
Memories and memory preferences can now sync across phones, tablets, and computers
Transfer files across devices, send files from your computer to your phone, and sea

[Xiaomi HyperIsland]
New: View all the important info at a glance with Xiaomi HyperIsland
New: Now you can pull down to expand small windows and handle multiple tasks more efficiently
[Comprehensive system app optimization]
Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi:
New: Support for continuous conversations with Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi while holding the Power button
  
Calendar:
Optimization: Holiday display in Calendar, with more traditional festivals and historical commemorative days
Fix: An issue where dates displayed incorrectly in some cases
     
Family Guard:
New: The option to view and edit Family Guard settings before you turn on Child mode
Optimization: Saving feature settings when turning off On-device guardianship
Optimization: Screen time stats in Child mode
      
Other improvements:
New: The option to tap the status bar to return to the top of the page in some apps and scenarios
Optimization: Visual feedback when you adjust screen brightness with the keyboard
Optimization: Mi Mover now supports transferring more data, including some settings and user data from system apps
Optimization: Home screen grid has been redesigned with more balanced margins and more comfortable spacing
Optimization: Gallery search animations for smoother transitions
Fix: Cloud drive file thumbnails in File Manager displayed incorrectly in some cases
Fix: An issue where macOS compressed files didn't display properly in File Manager in some cases
Fix: An issue where WeChat couldn't access screenshots in some cases
Fix: Stuttering when loading multilingual screenshot thumbnails in some cases
Optimization: The timeliness and accuracy of weather location updates when your location changes
[Interconnectivity]
New: Xiaomi tablets now support AirPods, including fast pair pop-ups, battery status, Spatial Audio, noise cancellation switching, and Find My
Optimization: Response speed for cross-device controls when using Xiaomi tablets with laptops
New: On Mac, Xiaomi Interconnectivity now lets you view Xiaomi Cloud Notes and Gallery
[Privacy and security]
New: With the Passwords app, you can auto-save, autofill, and sync end-to-end encrypted passwords across devices
New: More system apps now support Private access, with ongoing compatibility improvements for additional apps
Optimization: Updated "Fingerprints, face data, and screen lock" page layout for easier, faster setup
